source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, General Information and Lubrication, p.0-6

procedures.title: Lifting with a bumper (auto) jack: Corvette
steps: Place the jack on the shaded frame areas shown in figure 9 in the manual.
Check that the jack load rest bears properly on the frame before raising the car.
notes: On other models the jack goes under the bumpers; on the Corvette it goes on the frame.
